description: Checks whether a public GitHub, GitLab or Bitbucket repository will deploy: the services it found, what's missing (each with its fix), the environment variables it needs, and what it would cost a month on DigitalOcean, AWS, Google Cloud and Azure. Reads the code and changes nothing. Works without signing in. A check can take up to a minute; one still running returns a check_id that fetches its result.

check_id.description: The check_id of an earlier check, to get its result

name: check_repo
title: Check a repository
